notes:
- Timeline: see what you worked on, day by day – edited files, statuses and moves, grouped into work sessions (sidebar › Timeline)
- Timeline in every project: a week grid of folders × days, with the history of each file
- Report for a client: hours per day and edited files for a chosen range and project – copy as text or save as CSV
- Timeline settings: turn it off, ignore folders, remove single entries (files stay untouched) and restore them
